subject: Reasoning
topic: Classification — Odd One Out from Groups (W10 B2)

questions.stem: Find the odd one out: Apple, Mango, Banana, Carrot
questions.explanation: D is correct. Apple, Mango, and Banana are all fruits. Carrot is a vegetable (root vegetable). Trap: students who focus on 'orange coloured' might think Mango is odd, but the correct classifying criterion is fruit vs. vegetable.

questions.stem: Find the odd one out: Monday, Wednesday, Friday, February
questions.explanation: D is correct. Monday, Wednesday, and Friday are all days of the week. February is a month of the year. Trap: all four can be units of time, but the specific category (days of the week vs. months) distinguishes February.

D is correct. 16=4², 25=5², 36=6² are all perfect squares. 50 is not a perfect square (7²=49, 8²=64). Trap: students who test divisibility may be misled; only the perfect square property separates 50 from the rest.

questions.stem: Find the odd one out: Gold, Silver, Diamond, Copper
questions.explanation: C is correct. Gold, Silver, and Copper are all metals (pure elemental metals). Diamond is a non-metal — it is an allotrope of carbon. Trap: all four are precious/valuable materials, but the criterion is metal vs. non-metal. Diamond is the hardest known natural substance but is not a metal.

questions.stem: Find the odd one out: Nitrogen, Oxygen, Carbon dioxide, Argon
questions.explanation: C is correct. Nitrogen (N₂), Oxygen (O₂), and Argon (Ar) are all elements — pure substances consisting of one type of atom. Carbon dioxide (CO₂) is a compound made of two different elements (carbon + oxygen). Trap: all four are present in the atmosphere, but only Carbon dioxide is a compound rather than an element.

questions.stem: Find the odd one out: Sitar, Veena, Harmonium, Tambura
questions.explanation: C is correct. Sitar, Veena, and Tambura are all chordophone (string) instruments — sound produced by vibrating strings. The Harmonium is a keyboard instrument driven by bellows (a wind/reed instrument), where sound is produced by air flowing over metal reeds. Trap: all four are traditional Indian classical music instruments, so the category 'Indian music' doesn't help — the criterion is the instrument family (string vs. wind/reed).

D is correct. 8=2³, 27=3³, 64=4³, 125=5³ are all perfect cubes. 198 is not a perfect cube (6³=216, 5³=125; 198 falls between them and equals no cube of a whole number). Trap: 198 looks plausible as 2×99 or 6×33, but neither generates a cube relationship.

questions.stem: Find the odd one out among the letter groups: ACE, BDF, EFG, GIK
questions.explanation: C is correct. ACE: A(1)C(3)E(5) — each letter separated by +2. BDF: B(2)D(4)F(6) — each letter separated by +2. GIK: G(7)I(9)K(11) — each letter separated by +2. EFG: E(5)F(6)G(7) — letters separated by +1 (consecutive letters). EFG breaks the pattern of skipping one letter between each character in the group.

questions.stem: Find the odd one out: Panther, Jaguar, Leopard, Cheetah (consider roaring ability)
questions.explanation: D is correct. Panther, Jaguar, and Leopard (along with Tiger and Lion) are 'big cats' belonging to the genus Panthera and have the ability to ROAR. A Cheetah belongs to the genus Acinonyx — it cannot roar but can purr continuously. Cheetah is also the only cat that cannot fully retract its claws. Trap: all four are spotted wild cats, but roaring/non-roaring is the distinguishing biological feature.

questions.stem: Find the odd one out: Rajya Sabha, Lok Sabha, Vidhan Sabha, Zila Parishad
questions.explanation: D is correct. Rajya Sabha and Lok Sabha are houses of the Indian Parliament (Central Legislature). Vidhan Sabha is the lower house of a state legislature. All three are legislative bodies at the Central or State level. Zila Parishad is a local government body at the district level (Panchayati Raj institution) — not a legislative assembly at the state or central level. Trap: all four are elected/representative bodies, but the criterion is 'legislative assembly' vs. 'local government institution'.
